title: L’Oréal Kicks Off Partnership With Paris Saint-Germain
summary: The tie-in will include several L’Oréal brands, starting with Vichy Laboratoires.

extraction.key_fact: 로레알이 파리 생제르맹과의 파트너십을 시작하며 비시 라보라토리를 시작으로 여러 브랜드를 포함할 예정이다.
extraction.key_fact_quote:
L’Oréal Kicks Off Partnership With Paris Saint-Germain
The tie-in will include several L’Oréal brands, starting with Vichy Laboratoires.
